name: DHL Supply Chain - Mann+Hummel DC - Cowpens SC

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng landed on the NE edge of the building (ROOFTOP, moved 44m). Re-centered on the single massive cross-dock at 35.0610,-81.7820. Confirmed via web research as the 1,401,200 sq ft DHL/Mann+Hummel spec DC at 600 Webber Drive, Cowpens SC, opened July 2021 - the largest single building in the roster.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entrance off Webber Drive on the NE side - a divided 2-lane drive into the site. Site fenced (chain-link visible in Apr-2024 Street View). Long internal approach.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the entrance in z20 satellite or Street View; modern spec-building entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard booth -> remote/kiosk check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building with continuous dock-door rhythm on BOTH long faces (NW and SE); roster cites 104 dock doors. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the two opposite long faces of the building suggest separate shipping/receiving flows; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop rows along the SW yard and additional rows on the NE apron; perimeter truck-court loop road wraps the building.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal entrance road from Webber Drive and deep truck court easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide truck court and large undeveloped paved/graded area at the SW end - ample room for additional lanes.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Building runs diagonally (SE-NW), ~530m long; ~90 acres is the estimated fenced parcel of the building + wraparound truck court (the perimeter bounding box overstates the diagonal parcel). Low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx 95 trailers counted across both dock faces and drop rows; moderate confidence.

citations.claim: SC Dept of Commerce: DHL Supply Chain establishing 1.3M sq ft operations at 600 Webber Road, Cowpens (Cherokee County), $92.7M, 249 jobs.
Mann+Hummel supplier logistics manual names 600 Webber Road, 29330 Cowpens as its DHL-operated inbound DC.
DHL Supply Chain establishing Cowpens operations complex, Sunny Slope Industrial Park.

verification.rationale: Tier-1 econ-dev + Mann+Hummel's own 2024 logistics manual confirm DHL operates the dedicated Cowpens DC; no closure/WARN.
